jsesh.mdc.model
Class ItemAdapter

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdc.model.ItemAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelElementVisitor
public abstract class ItemAdapter
extends java.lang.Object
implements ModelElementVisitor

An ItemAdapter is a ModelElementVisitor designed to work on Items (Basic and Top). That is, all other elements are ignored. This adapter can be useful to guarentee that no (Basic|Top)Item is forgotten. This file is free Software (c) Serge Rosmorduc
